exposure: malignant ovarian mass diagnosed during pregnancy
type of ovarian tumor (serous/endocervical-type borderline tumor, primary epithelial ovarian carcinoma, metastatic tumor to the ovary, mucinous borderline tumor)
cohort: 22 pregnant women with a histological diagnosis of malignant ovarian mass
finding: Ultrasound morphological features of malignant ovarian masses detected during pregnancy are similar to those described in non-pregnant patients.
mod_finding: The likelihood of undergoing cesarean section increased with malignant disease in the ovary.
gest_age: Median gestational age at diagnosis was 13.5 weeks (range 4-30 weeks)
